premises.text: Student attention spans and social-app habits make two-hour textbook study sessions hard to sustain
premises.evidence_span: My generation has half the attention span that the generation before me did

premises.text: Personalized, addictive generative-AI learning can help students learn faster and teachers teach faster
premises.evidence_span: what if we could make learning personalized? What if we could make learning addictive

premises.text: Kado converts a textbook photo via OCR and ML into categorized flashcards in under thirty seconds
premises.evidence_span: in a matter of mere seconds, you get flashcards

premises.text: Milo places a virtual tutor in messaging apps so students get Q&A and study help without leaving where they already spend time
premises.evidence_span: we went back to the drawing board and went to what students do most

premises.text: Training task-specific behavior into language models with product data yields 200ms Q&A versus ~1200ms industry benchmarks
premises.evidence_span: training task-specific behavior in the model itself

premises.text: Models extend beyond students to university repository distillation and enterprise employee training
premises.evidence_span: We now use our AI models beyond just students, and we're able to service workplace and training

premises.text: Builders who are themselves student users ensure the information pipeline fits peer learning habits
premises.evidence_span: we are our own user. Me and my co-founders are 19 years old

value.text: Faster learning for students (and teaching for teachers) via seamless generative study tools
value.evidence_span: help students learn faster and help teachers teach faster

secondary_value.evidence_span: seamless learning experience for your workforce and upskilling them as fast as possible

causal_links.evidence_span: Our attention wasn't where we wanted it to be. So we went back to the drawing board and went to what students do most
the competition for attention today is so fierce
This was a process that took me two hours in school, now being done by our users in less than 30 seconds
we have a fantastic, seamless user experience
building an information pipeline that not just we could use, but our peers could use

P1->P4 on explicit pivot warrant.
